stygar_trait: Mastitis detection (Lely on line California mastitis test, 43) and Health disorder e.g. mastitis or pneumonia (HerdInsights, 30), Table 2 page 7, both commercial farm
evidence_note: Stygar Table 2 page 7 lists Lely on line CMT (43) under Mastitis detection and HerdInsight (30) under Health disorder, both validated on commercial farms; Table 1 page 6 places 43 and 30 in the independent column. Appendix aims: FirstLook Mastitis system names mastitis identification; ten aims name udder health. Maroto Molina do not discuss clinical mastitis incidence (I006).
notes: Candidates: validated_commercial, because Stygar validate detection of mastitis cases on commercial farms; none, because the EFSA ABM is the incidence rate of clinical cases from veterinary or farm records, not detection. Listed in notes/unsure.md. Hardware class given for the cheapest commercial candidate, inline milk sensing in the milking system, per the unsure rule in definitions.md.

evidence_note: Keyword scan: 0 aims name bulk milk or bulk tank. The SCC products in the appendix measure single animals or quarters: Lely MQC-C (validated, ref 43) somatic cell count of each cow, LIC Protrack SCC individual somatic cell count, GEA M6850 SCC on each udder quarter; DeLaval OCC and DCC aims say udder health monitoring. That is the Welfare Quality measure I057, not bulk tank SCC. Maroto Molina do not discuss bulk tank SCC.
notes: EFSA Table 27 page 43 rates bulk milk SCC high feasibility because records are readily available, with low sensitivity; the definitions class somatic cell count from records as routine_data, so the class is routine_data although no PLF product measures the bulk tank.

stygar_trait: Active behavior (walking, no. of steps), Table 2 page 7
evidence_note: Stygar Table 2 page 7, Active behavior (walking, no. of steps): every entry sits in the lower performance column, research farms CowManager SensOor (17, 39, 40), IceTag (28), Lely activity (42), RumiWatch (38), commercial farms CowScout Leg (27), IceTag (26, 27); page 6 text: for active behavior, lower performance of tools was reported. Table 1 page 6 columns: 39, 40, 28 and 26 independent; 17 and 38 self; on the IceTag row 21 and 26 to 28 sit in the independent column while the supplementary table codes 27 (Nielsen 2018) self, and on the CowScout Leg row 27 sits in the self column, so for P013 both sources agree on self. Appendix aims naming steps or walking: IceTag, IceQube, CowScout S.
notes: The keyword activity matches 39 aims, most of them activity monitoring for heat detection, which is step based accelerometry; the count is reported as is and the keywords are visible. EFSA Table 31 rates on farm feasibility low; the appendix shows the opposite for the market. Table 1 also lists Lely activity (42, Elischer 2013, independent) but no appendix row is named Lely activity and no Lely row other than MQC-C carries a validation flag, so ref 42 is not attached to a product here. RumiWatch is not in products.csv and is cited as an appendix product.
